primary_sources.description: Official divisions, districts, upazilas and union lists
Official postal codes and post offices directories

audit_summary.notes: Union coverage: 4,540 unions out of 4,568 published national portal total verified with direct .gov.bd subdomains (99.39% coverage). The remaining 28 unions represent recently bifurcated or unindexed union parishads not yet populated with individual government web portals. Post offices: 1,347 official post offices and postal codes with leading-zero string preservation.
